settings: smoothing off, online offset batch (alpha 0.2, eta_b 0.05 per 2 s batch)
box_drawn: raw 5-95% box (q05/q95 along and across heading, logged in plans[*]['pred']), the box run_closed's inloop_cov90 scores; not the q15-85 + online-offset box the planner steers with
truth: features.build_rows(full history, h = 2 s, row_every = dt) true positions, inner-merged on (agent_id, t), as Predictor.inloop_stats
post_definition: forecast made at t >= switch_t (so the first post forecasts come due at switch_t + 2 s)
nominal_joint_coverage: a 5-95% interval on each of two axes covers ~0.9 x 0.9 = 81% jointly if calibrated and independent
box_width_and_score_post_meaning: run_episode's in-loop aggregates after the switch: w90 = mean 5-95% width per axis (m), is90 = interval score (width + 20 x miss distance; lower is better, so wider boxes do not win it for free), err = median error of the median forecast (m)
grey_people: not scored: a person who reaches their goal respawns under a new id; new arrivals have no forecast yet and people about to arrive have no 2 s outcome (dropped the same way in T5)

window.note: forecasts made at t >= 5 s that came due by 20 s (what the GIF's last frame shows)
